headline: Public hearings on projects at South Willow Street, Gold Street, Wellington Road, Chestnut Street, and Mammoth Road, plus other site and subdivision applications.
summary: The agenda lists continued and new applications for subdivisions, site plans, and conditional use permits. It also includes compliance hearings and amendments to earlier approvals.
items: S2026-005: Subdivision for 34 new buildable lots on Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lot 30), continued from July 2, 2026. Request to continue to September 3, 2026.

SP2026-010: Site plan for a charitable gaming facility of 73,240 sq. ft. (formerly 63,175 sq. ft.) with 1,086 parking spaces (formerly 562) on five lots at South Willow Street, John E. Devine Drive, and Gold Street, continued from July 16, 2026.

CU2026-004: Conditional use permit to reduce required parking during phased construction at the same five lots, continued from July 16, 2026. The existing facility stays open until the new facility is granted occupancy.
S2026-011: Lot line adjustment between Lots 6 and 7B at 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive, giving Lot 6 a total of 41,659 SF, continued from July 16, 2026.

SP2026-011: Site plan to raze a former fueling station at 1265 South Willow Street and build a new fueling station with a convenience store, drive-through restaurant, and fueling canopy, continued from July 16, 2026.
CU2026-005: Conditional use permit to reduce on-site parking at 1265 South Willow Street from 19 required spaces to 14 spaces, continued from July 16, 2026.
SP2022-011: Compliance hearing for a five-story apartment building with 98 dwelling units at 351 Chestnut Street.
PDSP2024-002: Compliance hearing on the architectural details of a proposed 457-space steel frame parking deck at Orange Street and Pearl Street (Tax Map 41, Lot 3A).
SP2026-007: Amendment to conditions of approval for converting a two-family building at 192 Mammoth Road into four multi-family units.
S2026-015: Lot line adjustment at 975 Cedar St, Auburn Street, and 1040 Auburn Street, reducing the number of lots from three to two.
SP2026-015: Site plan to add 4 new units to an existing 3-unit building at 159 Union Street.
SP2023-015: Amendment to redevelop the parking lot at 25 Lowell Street into a new 71-space private parking lot.
SP2026-014: Site plan to convert a two-family building at 434 Hevey Street into four multi-family residential units.
location: City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza, Manchester, New Hampshire 03101

 MANCHESTER PLANNING BOARD 
PUBLIC HEARING MEETING AGENDA 
Wednesday, August 5, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers 
 
I. The Chair calls the meeting to order and introduces Planning Board members and Planning 
staff. 
 
II. PUBLIC HEARING: 
 
1. S2026-005 – Continued from July 2, 2026 
Property located at Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lot 30), a subdivision application for the 
creation of 34 new buildable lots with new public roads and a wetland crossing, in the Lake 
Massabesic Protection Overlay and R-1A Zoning District. Granite Engineering, LLC for 
Manchester Water Works. (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance) 
Request for continuance to September 3, 2026 
 
2. SP2026-010 – Continued from July 16, 2026 
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a new site p lan application for 
the redevelopment of five lots (formerly three lots) into a single lot of record for a proposed 73,240 
sq. ft. (formerly 63,175 sq. ft.) Charitable Gaming Facility with 1,086 parking spaces (formerly 
562) and the associ ated site improve ments, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fus s & O’Neill, Inc. for 
Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC.  (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance) 
 
3. CU2026-004 – Continued from July 16, 2026 
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a conditional use permit is for a 
reduction in required parking due to the phasing of construction. The applicant seeks to keep the 
existing facility until the new facility is granted occupancy, at such time the existing facility is to be 
razed and the remainder of th e parking field would be completed, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss 
& O’Neill, Inc. for Granite State Poker Al liance, LLC . (Reviewed under Current Zoning 
Ordinance) 
 
4. S2026-011 – Continued from July 16, 2026

41,659 SF for Lot 6, in a BC-2 Zoning District. Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Aranosian Oil Company, 
Inc. and Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)

 (New Items) 
With respect to the following applications, appropriate materials have been submitted to invoke the 
jurisdiction of the Board. Although additional information may be required prior to final 
consideration, it is the recommendation of Staff that the Planning Board determine the applications 
complete and conduct a public hearing. A motion would be in order. 
 
7. SP2022-011 - Compliance Hearing 
Property located at  351 Chestnut Street (Tax Map 73, Lot 001), a compliance hearing for the

Zoning Ordinance)
